# District Data Workflow

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_cses_wiki.py. Review before manual editing. -->

## Purpose

Use this when asked how to collect, check, or document CSES district-level data.

## Use When

Keywords and signals: district, constituency, electoral district.

## Standard Workflow

1. Start with the current district-data training page for operational practice.
2. Use the older district-data guideline as background if a concise rule is needed.
3. Check whether the request concerns raw collection, cross-national comparability, documentation, or release review.
4. Escalate to original source documents when country-specific district definitions or historical exceptions matter.
